description: This file contains constants, classes, and functions related to WebSocket protocol handling, including version definitions, header constants, status codes, and extension parsing utilities.

classes.name: ExtensionParameter
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket extension with its parameters, used during extension negotiation.

methods.name: is_control_opcode
methods.description: Checks if the given opcode is a control frame.

methods.name: ExtensionParameter.__init__
methods.description: Initializes an extension with a name.

methods.name: ExtensionParameter.name
methods.description: Returns the name of the extension.

methods.name: ExtensionParameter.add_parameter
methods.description: Adds a parameter to the extension.

methods.name: ExtensionParameter.get_parameters
methods.description: Returns all parameters of the extension.

methods.name: ExtensionParameter.get_parameter_names
methods.description: Returns the list of parameter names.

methods.name: ExtensionParameter.has_parameter
methods.description: Checks if a parameter with the given name exists.

methods.name: ExtensionParameter.get_parameter_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific parameter.

methods.name: _parse_extension_param
methods.description: Parses a single extension parameter from the header state.

methods.name: _parse_extension
methods.description: Parses an entire extension from the header state.

methods.name: parse_extensions
methods.description: Parses the Sec-WebSocket-Extensions header into extension objects.

methods.name: format_extension
methods.description: Formats an ExtensionParameter object into a header string.

methods.name: format_extensions
methods.description: Formats a list of ExtensionParameter objects into a header string.
